about: Official cautions: the exact words of government health agencies, quoted, never paraphrased. Each statement was checked against the official document on 18 Oct 2026 (see proposals/official-warnings-verified.json). quote_zh is a translation; the English quote is the original. Approved by the owner on 18 Oct 2026.

statements.document_en: EU herbal monograph on ginkgo leaf (EMA/HMPC/321097/2012)
statements.quote_en: If the medicinal product is taken concomitantly with anticoagulants (e.g. phenprocoumon and warfarin) or antiplatelet drugs (e.g. clopidogrel, acetylsalicylic acid and other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), their effect may be influenced.
statements.quote_zh: 如果呢種藥同抗凝血藥（例如苯丙香豆素同華法林）或者抗血小板藥（例如氯吡格雷、乙醯水楊酸〔阿士匹靈〕同其他非類固醇消炎藥）一齊用，佢哋嘅效果可能會受到影響。

statements.document_en: EU herbal monograph on ginkgo leaf (EMA/HMPC/321097/2012)
statements.quote_en: Ginkgo leaf may increase the effects of anticoagulants such as coumarin derivatives.
statements.quote_zh: 銀杏葉可能會加強香豆素類抗凝血藥嘅效果。

statements.quote_en: Do not use if you are taking blood thinners or other health products that affect blood coagulation (Gardner and McGuffin 2013; Brinker 2010; Bent 2005).
statements.quote_zh: 如果你食緊薄血藥，或者其他會影響血液凝固嘅健康產品，就唔好用。

statements.quote_en: Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are taking diabetes, high blood pressure or seizure medications (Brinker 2010).
statements.quote_zh: 如果你食緊糖尿病、高血壓或者癲癇嘅藥，用之前要先問醫護人員或者醫生。

statements.section_zh: 注意事項及警告（所有產品）
statements.quote_en: Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are taking blood thinners or digoxin (Brinker 2010; Dasgupta et al. 2007; Elmer et al. 2007; Yuan et al. 2004).
statements.quote_zh: 如果你食緊薄血藥或者地高辛，用之前要先問醫護人員或者醫生。

statements.quote_en: Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are taking antidepressant medication, blood thinners or digoxin (Brinker 2010; Lee et al. 2008a; Dasgupta and Reyes 2005; Janetzki and Morreale 1997; Gonzalez-Seijo et al. 1995; Shader and Greenblatt 1988; Jones and Runikis 1987; Shader and Greenblatt 1985).
statements.quote_zh: 如果你食緊抗抑鬱藥、薄血藥或者地高辛，用之前要先問醫護人員或者醫生。

statements.document_en: EU herbal monograph on liquorice root, Revision 1 (EMA/HMPC/108399/2024)
statements.document_zh: 歐盟甘草根草藥專論第1次修訂（EMA/HMPC/108399/2024）
statements.quote_en: Liquorice root may counteract antihypertensive action of prescribed medications.
statements.quote_zh: 甘草根可能會抵消處方降血壓藥嘅作用。

statements.document_en: EU herbal monograph on liquorice root, Revision 1 (EMA/HMPC/108399/2024)
statements.document_zh: 歐盟甘草根草藥專論第1次修訂（EMA/HMPC/108399/2024）
statements.quote_en: Not to be used concomitantly with diuretics, cardiac glycosides, corticosteroids, stimulant laxatives or other medications which may aggravate electrolyte imbalance (see section with 4.4).
statements.quote_zh: 唔可以同利尿藥、強心苷、類固醇、刺激性瀉藥，或者其他可能令電解質失衡加劇嘅藥物一齊用（見第4.4節）。
